usage: <client> [-h] [--model MODEL] [--task TASK] [--outcome ID OUTCOME]
                 [--envelope] [--json] [--think] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--stats]
                 [--num-ctx NUM_CTX] [--est-mb EST_MB] [--wait WAIT]
                 [--allow-reload]
                 [prompt]

<client>: send one prompt to the local Ollama box and print the answer.

positional arguments:
  prompt

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL
  --task TASK           required for a real call: a short label for the log,
                        e.g. triage
  --outcome ID OUTCOME  record what was done with call ID's answer:
                        accepted|rewritten|discarded|fact-error
  --envelope            print {"call_id", "model", "response"} as JSON instead
                        of the bare answer
  --json                ask Ollama for JSON output
  --think               let a thinking model think
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --stats
  --num-ctx NUM_CTX     num_ctx this call declares (the loaded one is sent)
  --est-mb EST_MB       estimated VRAM for this call, MB
  --wait WAIT           seconds to wait for a slot before exit 75
  --allow-reload        send the declared num_ctx even if it differs from the
                        loaded one
